races.name: Racing Again November 19th Beginners Chase
races.verdict:
WHISPERING WILLOW underperformed over hurdles last time but had previously shaped well over fences and is worth chancing back in this sphere with first-time cheekpieces applied. In-form hurdler Might Be The One is feared most if transferring that ability to fences with Kimy also respected after a promising chase debut at Tramore.

  1. WHISPERING WILLOW (IRE)
  2. MIGHT BE THE ONE (IRE)
  3. KIMY (FR)

races.name: Horse & Jockey Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
STONEYFORD LADY scored over C&D last year and bounced back from a Ballinrobe fall with a good second at Killarney last month. She looks sure to make a bold bid now returned to this venue. Listowel chase winner Potters Pal is open to further improvement on debut for a new yard with Aurea Fortuna also respected after bouncing back to form last time.

  1. STONEYFORD LADY (IRE)
  2. POTTERS PAL (FR)
  3. AUREA FORTUNA (IRE)

races.name: www.thurlesraces.ie Handicap Chase (0-100)
races.verdict:
ONEFORTHEDITCH would have gone close but for uncharacteristic errors on her last 2 starts and can gain compensation here with a clear round of jumping. Way Down South has had issues with his jumping in the past but is well treated on his recent hurdling win and rates the main danger, while both Tantrum Boy and Gortmore Lady are also capable of being in the mix if putting their best foot forward.

  1. ONEFORTHEDITCH (IRE)
  2. WAY DOWN SOUTH (IRE)
  3. TANTRUM BOY (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
DOCTOR ELVIS put a poor effort behind him when runner-up last time and looks to have been found an excellent opening to finally get off the mark. Unexposed Zambezi Moon is feared most, with The Goose’s Acre making most appeal of the remainder.

  1. DOCTOR ELVIS (FR)
  2. ZAMBEZI MOON (IRE)
  3. THE GOOSE'S ACRE (IRE)

races.name: Sign Up To GavinLynchRacing.com Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
This looks a fine opportunity for GUNNERY SERGEANT to finally get off the mark in a thin race. Beeverstown Boy can chase the selection home, whilst Flashy Fred's bumper form would entitle him to be in the mix.

  1. GUNNERY SERGEANT (FR)
  2. BEEVERSTOWN BOY (FR)
  3. FLASHY FRED (IRE)

races.name: Book Your Christmas Party Here On December 19th Mares Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
THEFLYINGBEE ticks plenty of boxes and could be the answer in a tricky handicap. Stablemates Fratas and Shoda are feared most.

  1. THEFLYINGBEE (IRE)
  2. FRATAS (IRE)
  3. SHODA (IRE)

races.name: Two-Mile Borris Handicap Hurdle (0-100) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
This looks quite a shallow affair, so in-form LICEO makes most appeal on the back of several creditable efforts in defeat. Grennanstown Lady has upped her game of late and can make the placings again, whilst Daisy Fingall should do better now handicapping.

  1. LICEO (FR)
  2. GRENNANSTOWN LADY (IRE)
  3. DAISY FINGALL (IRE)

races.name: Two-Mile Borris Handicap Hurdle (0-100) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
TOPOTHELANE can make it 2 wins from his last 3 starts if ready to roll. Thegooseiscooked could be the main threat with Daniel King booked, while Chesterbaylad, Sinbad My Dad and Euro Maker also merit consideration in an open-looking handicap.

  1. TOPOTHELANE (IRE)
  2. THEGOOSEISCOOKED (IRE)
  3. CHESTERBAYLAD (IRE)

races.name: CopyBet Back Again At Hereford Fillies' Juvenile Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
PRINCESS OF HABO's Flat form on the continent is the best on offer and she can make a winning start over hurdles having joined the increasingly powerful Jamie Snowden team. Koala Rose was also above average on the level and is much respected now representing Dan Skelton, whilst C&D winner Echo Valley took well to this discipline on her debut in this sphere.

  1. PRINCESS OF HABO (IRE)
  2. KOALA ROSE (IRE)
  3. ECHO VALLEY

races.name: Paul Fergusons Jumpers To Follow EBF 'National Hunt' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Dual-bumper winner GOVERNORS ROCK was found out in better company at Cheltenham last time, but this looks a good opportunity for him to resume winning ways. Moscow Star was much improved from hurdling debut when runner-up at Sedgefield last month and can give the selection most to think about, ahead of Jaunty Trooper, who has shown some promise in bumpers and has a fine jumping pedigree.

  1. GOVERNORS ROCK (IRE)
  2. MOSCOW STAR (FR)
  3. JAUNTY TROOPER

races.name: CopyBet For Nations League Profit Boosts Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
MR JUKEBOX went close to defying a penalty at Perth when last seen and Warren Greatrex's charge remains unexposed as a handicapper, so gets the verdict over Lydeard Girl who signed off last season with a career-best second at Wincanton. Recent Market Rasen winner Lightning Flash is also considered after a 7 lb rise.

  1. MR JUKEBOX (IRE)
  2. LYDEARD GIRL
  3. LIGHTNING FLASH (IRE)

races.name: CopyBet BOG Now For Cheltenham Tomorrow Novices' Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
ONEINTHEWELL's latest form is working out well, and he may just get away with the return to a right-handed track. Alan Bresil could be the main danger if blinkers continue to have a positive effect. Stable debutant Elated shades Cinnodin (finished third on Tuesday) in the best-of-the-rest vote.

  1. ONEINTHEWELL (IRE)
  2. ALAN BRESIL
  3. ELATED

races.name: CopyBet Overnight Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
TARITINO has presumably been freshened up following a busy/productive season on the Flat and could be weighted to add to his hurdles tally. Thriving Seraphic is feared if taking up this engagement, with lightly-raced Gaelic Saint preferred to Maasai Mara among the remainder.

  1. TARITINO (IRE)
  2. SERAPHIC (IRE)
  3. GAELIC SAINT

races.name: CopyBet Support Safer Gambling Mares' Open Maiden NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
MS BELLE was runner-up on her sole outing in points and is certainly bred for the job, so she's put forward as the answer having been found a weak-looking race for her Rules debut. Eagles Promise is narrowly preferred to Three Of Spades for the forecast spot.

  1. MS BELLE
  2. EAGLES PROMISE (IRE)
  3. THREE OF SPADES (IRE)

races.name: PricedUp Bet Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A tough call to split interesting pair BALLYDINE BOY and Northern Olympian. Olly Murphy's fairly useful bumper winner narrowly shades the vote on hurdling debut.

  1. BALLYDINE BOY (IRE)
  2. NORTHERN OLYMPIAN (GER)
  3. SHOW YOUR HAND

races.name: PricedUp Now With Best Odds 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
An interesting maiden. EASTERN ROCK shaped better than the distance beaten suggests on his hurdling debut at Fontwell last month, paying the price for a big move into contention, and looks sure to build on that promise. Ivor Bear was no match for a speedier sort on his first go over hurdles at this course recently but can be expected to improve upped in trip, while multiple-winning Irish pointer Supreme Force also commands plenty of respect for an in-form stable.

  1. EASTERN ROCK (IRE)
  2. IVOR BEAR (IRE)
  3. SUPREME FORCE (IRE)

races.name: PricedUp Boosted Prices Daily Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
TELL THE TALE surpassed his hurdles form when making a winning chase debut at Ffos Las last month and he can follow up from a 6 lb higher mark. Catwalk Girl also made a winning start over fences back in the spring and is respected, with Western George appealing as one who should do better now chasing.

  1. TELL THE TALE (IRE)
  2. CATWALK GIRL (IRE)
  3. WESTERN GEORGE (IRE)

races.name: Lincolnshire Rural Support Network Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
NOBLE RECALL has proved consistent this autumn and can go one place better than he did at this track last month. Miss Denver is also shortlisted swiftly returned to chasing, whilst Crac de Megaudais also merits consideration on the back of his Stratford success.

  1. NOBLE RECALL
  2. MISS DENVER
  3. CRAC DE MEGAUDAIS (FR)

races.name: NFU Mutual Agriculture Raceday Novices' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
THIS SWAY was in good form in the spring and can make a winning seasonal return. Stylia has undergone an interesting stable switch and looks on a competitive mark if still retaining her ability after an 18-month absence, whilst Teofimo was seen to maximum effect when scoring at Newcastle last week but is clearly on decent terms with himself.

  1. THIS SWAY
  2. STYLIA (FR)
  3. TEOFIMO (IRE)

races.name: PricedUp Boosts And BOG Mares' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Not much to separate BURNING EMBERS and Reflection Of You, with Dan Skelton's unexposed 5-y-o narrowly preferred. Fireball Frenzy and It's Maisy also merit consideration in a tight-looking handicap.

  1. BURNING EMBERS (IRE)
  2. REFLECTION OF YOU
  3. FIREBALL FRENZY (IRE)

races.name: PricedUp Bet Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
ST FAZ thrived on the Flat for shrewd connections this year and looks well worth another chance in this sphere. The most solid of the dangers is Tilehurst, who goes well for Sean Bowen, with Ballygeary and Moutarde both potentially interesting if on a going day.

  1. ST FAZ (FR)
  2. TILEHURST
  3. MOUTARDE (IRE)
